shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/medical/power/pipes/climate, stairs/ladders/elevators, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. DBH + VEF PipeSystem soft compat; Reverse Commands soft compat (reflection-only).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid mineable rock, thick-roofed, 12C.
- Animal policy (conservative): pets follow master, obedient pets get send gizmos, non-pen unrestricted pets cross for food; pen animals never.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x), grand staircase 2x2 (0.6x, quality scales climb), elevator (0.35x, power bridge, Extend gizmos, two-hop rides).
- Climb = 90t x type x quality x slider. All minifiable (uninstall collapses far side). Bomb >= 40 punches constructed rooftops. Giddy-Up mounted riders blocked.
- Stairs do NOT unroof anything below. Sky-side landing platforms (footprint+1) are RoofSurface, exempt from air-reversion while stairs stand.
- Migration diagnostics: verbose-logging lines at each TryTowards decision (no stairs / no reachable work from exit / migrating) - playtest false alarm resolved with them (settings or layout, chain verified intact).

## Sky surface model (round-6 spec 2026-07-19)
- Three owned terrains: AB_OpenAir (see-through, impassable), AB_RoofSurface (corrugated steel, muted vanilla-toned), AB_MountainTop (flat fog-toned cap, walk/build, pathCost 2).
- COVERED-BELOW rule (LevelSync.CoveredBelow, shared by genstep + events + sweep): constructed roof below, OR artificial impassable edifice (wall/door) supporting an adjacent constructed roof - steel runs to the OUTER wall edge. Roof events re-sync the 8 neighbors; wall-only changes converge on the sweep.
- MOUNTAIN CAP: the entire mountain-derived floor - ledge ring, thin-roof rim, and the floor revealed by mining the mass - is AB_MountainTop, so from above the mountain reads exactly like the fogged mass seen from the surface (playtest request round 6, "highest visual consistency"). Wall edge strips border it like vanilla fog edges; player floors cover it (Heavy affordance).
- Mountains: mass erodes one step to the walkable unfogged ledge; wall core solid rock + thick roof; fog deep interior only (all walls within radius 2) - fogging faces swallowed the ledge (round-4 regression, reverted). Ore lumps in the mass.
- Sync self-heal: subscription retry (250t) + ReconcileRooftops (FinalizeInit + 2000t), platform-exempt, CoveredBelow-driven; natural roofs generation-time only.

## See-below renderer (final architecture)
- Static pass: lower map's section meshes via cloned materials in a queue band derived at RUNTIME from a real terrain material (map shaders do not depth-write; guessed constants failed twice). Terrain -300 ... things -200 + altitude step ... overlays -80 under the measured ceiling.
- Dynamic pass: ONE-WAY MIRROR - below things draw only if unroofed (any roof), unfogged, in view, under open air. Filtered per-thing loop, reflection fallback to unfiltered.
- Air-cells light mask (night cap 0.45) over air cells only; silhouettes suppressed; ceiling hints; far clip 70. Weather decider suppressed on pocket levels; surface sync drives.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified in-game 2026-07-19)
- Logistics: outbound haul + inbound fetch + demand pull + export pinning + carried-cargo delivery. Column-aware stuff picker (transpiler + ResourceCounter augmentation).
- Needs: rest to owned bed anywhere in column or free bed on linked level; food redirect incl. eligible pets. Medical rescue + capture via CarriedIntent.
- One-colony UI: tables append other levels (Fluffy Animal Tab via RecachePawns); colonist bar ordered per column; level buttons in global controls (Declutter bypass); camera preserved; beds alert aggregated.
- Power/pipes/climate bridges per link; ABPendingOrders replay; ABOreGen (6/10k, commonality-weighted) in basement + sky mass.

## Performance architecture
- ABGuard plain-bool switches; AnySkyLevels static gate; NearestUsableStairsCached per-tick memo; shared stairs helpers; small caches. Recurring: weather 150t, pipes/climate 250t, power 10t hash, rooftop sweep 2000t. Zero recurring cost with no levels.

## Compat
- DBH + VEF bridges; Reverse Commands; Fluffy Animal Tab; Declutter UI; Giddy-Up; incompatibleWith MultiFloors + ZLevels1.1; RimThreaded unsupported; foreign pocket maps read as level-0.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Floating rim/cap cells on natural roof loss (rare); sky projectile dim over air; tall below-sprites clip at rooftop edges; wall-only edits converge on sweep cadence (<=33s); bill radius vs stairs delivery; couples as singles in beds alert; RC direct links only; restaurants per-level; stuff picker direct links only.
- Threat policy: pocket levels raid-free; opt-ins slated for T8.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T10 DONE. Optimization + compat pass DONE. Playtest rounds 2-6 DONE (2026-07-19): stuff picker, ore gen, retry+sweep, queue-band renderer, one-way mirror, wall-edge rooftop, muted steel texture, ledge regression reverted, migration diagnostics, flat mountain cap. Round-6 pending relaunch verification (fresh map needed for the cap).
- Next: T5 publishing prep. Backlog: T8 threat opt-ins, T9 pipe depth, T11 world integration.

## Status
Round-6 mountain cap implemented and compiling. Awaiting relaunch verification, then T5 publishing prep.
